actual: Restaurant list and detail pages show only symbolic price tier ($, $$, $$$, $$$$) rather than an actual average price per diner amount. Name, cuisine, rating, location, description, and dining features (e.g. Private Dining, Wine Pairing) are all present, but no numeric average price value exists anywhere on the page (confirmed via DOM scan for $-prefixed numbers).

evidence: Search by name "Sakura" and by neighborhood "Waterfront" each correctly returned the single matching restaurant. Cuisine filter "Japanese" correctly narrowed to 1 restaurant (Sakura Garden). Combining Japanese cuisine filter with "$$ - Moderate" price filter (Sakura Garden is $$$) correctly returned "No restaurants found matching your criteria," confirming all active criteria are jointly enforced.

Clicking "Confirm Reservation" with all fields empty produced no reservation (form remained on page, no navigation, no new item in reservations). With Name/Phone filled but Email set to invalid "notanemail", submission was again blocked; DOM inspection confirmed the Email input has type="email" and required=true with native validationMessage "Please include an '@' in the email address. 'notanemail' is missing an '@'." and validity.valid=false — i.e. the browser's built-in validation identifies the missing/invalid field to the user and prevents submission. Date, Time, Name, Email, and Phone are all marked required (*) and enforced.

Selected future date Aug 26, 2026, time 19:00, party size 2 Guests, filled Name/Email/Phone, submitted. Got "Reservation Confirmed! Your table at The Golden Fork is booked for August 26, 2026 at 19:00." Reservation then appeared in Upcoming Reservations (1) with matching restaurant, date, time, and party size.

Applied WELCOME10 coupon, saw "Coupon Applied! 10% off your first reservation" with the discount displayed ("WELCOME10 - 10% off"). Removed it via the remove button, coupon field reverted to entry input. Re-applied WELCOME10 and submitted the reservation; the resulting entry in My Reservations shows "Coupon applied: WELCOME10".

In the date picker, all dates through Aug 25, 2026 (today and earlier) were rendered as disabled gridcells; Aug 26, 2026 onward were selectable. After selecting Aug 26, 2026, the Time dropdown listed available slots (17:00–21:00 in 30-min increments), and the combination of that future date with an available time (19:00) was successfully used to complete a reservation.

issue: Coupon eligibility rules (first-reservation, day) not enforced
actual: Party-size rule works correctly: GROUP15 was rejected for a 2-guest party with message "This coupon requires a party of 6 or more." However: (1) First-reservation rule not enforced — after already completing one reservation with email testuser@example.com using WELCOME10 ("10% off your first reservation"), the same coupon was accepted again on a second reservation for the same email without any rejection. (2) Day rule not enforced — WEEKEND20 ("20% off weekend dining") was accepted for Wednesday, August 26, 2026, a weekday, with no rejection. The UI does correctly prevent applying a second coupon on top of an already-applied one (input is replaced by a single applied-coupon pill), so the "at most one coupon" rule holds, but two of the three stated eligibility conditions are not actually validated.

issue: Date cannot be changed when modifying a reservation
actual: The "Modify Reservation" dialog opened from an upcoming reservation only exposes "New Time" and "Party Size" fields — there is no date field or control to change the reservation's date. Changing time (19:00→19:30) and party size (2→4 Guests) worked correctly and was saved and reflected in the reservation list, but the date (August 26, 2026) could not be modified through this dialog, so the requirement to change date, time, and party size is only partially met.

evidence: Creating a reservation showed an immediate "Reservation Confirmed!" toast/panel and it appeared in Upcoming without reload. Modifying time/party size showed an immediate "Reservation Updated - Your reservation has been modified successfully." toast and the reservation card in the same view updated to 19:30 / 4 Guests instantly, without a manual page reload.

Clicked Cancel on The Golden Fork upcoming reservation; a confirmation dialog "Cancel Reservation?" appeared. Confirming showed "Reservation Cancelled" toast, the reservation immediately disappeared from Upcoming (2→1), and appeared in Past (0→1) tab with status "Cancelled" and all original details (date, time, party size, location, coupon) retained.

"Modify" button opened a "Modify Reservation" dialog with editable Time and Party Size controls and a "Save Changes" button; changes saved and were reflected in the list. "Cancel" button opened an explicit "Cancel Reservation?" confirmation alertdialog with "Keep Reservation" / "Cancel Reservation" buttons; the cancellation only took effect after clicking "Cancel Reservation" to confirm.

Upcoming reservations show status badge "Upcoming"; after cancellation, the item is shown in the Past tab with status badge "Cancelled" — visually distinguishable. Each reservation card displays restaurant name, date, time, party size, status, location (neighborhood, e.g. "Downtown"/"Arts District"), and applied coupon (e.g. "Coupon applied: WELCOME10") when present.

issue: Rating shown on restaurant list is inconsistent with restaurant details and does not update after new reviews
actual: Restaurant list initially showed The Golden Fork at rating 4.8, while its own details page showed 4.5 (2) — the two values were inconsistent even before any new review was submitted. After submitting a 3-star review, the details page correctly recalculated to 4.0 (3) and the new review appeared under Reviews (3), but the restaurant list page (revisited after submission) still displayed the stale 4.8 rating, unchanged by the new review. The list-page rating is not derived from/consistent with the details-page review data.

evidence: On The Golden Fork's "Write a Review" tab, selected a 3-star rating, entered Name "QA Tester", Date of Visit "2026-08-20", and review text; submission produced "Review Submitted! Thank you for sharing your experience." The new review then appeared in the Reviews tab (now Reviews (3)) with the correct name, 3-star rating, visit date "Aug 20, 2026", and text, listed only under The Golden Fork (not on other restaurants).

issue: Reviews can be submitted without any completed reservation at the restaurant
actual: The "Write a Review" form on a restaurant's page (Star rating, Name, Date of Visit, Review text) has no linkage to the reviewer's reservations and no check for a completed visit. A review for The Golden Fork was submitted successfully even though the only reservation ever held there by this session had been Cancelled (not completed) at the time of submission — the site accepted the review with no eligibility validation and no way to select/reference a qualifying reservation. This also means the "one review per completed reservation" cap cannot be enforced since there's no reservation-review linkage at all.
